Banners and products currently use free Unsplash photos (see src/data.js). To use your own, put files here and replace the unsplash(...) calls with paths like /images/products/sakura-milk.jpg.

banners/        banner-1.jpg, banner-2.jpg, banner-3.jpg     (wide, ~16:9)
products/       sakura-milk.jpg, sakura-milk-pro.jpg, condensed-milk.jpg, sweet-condensed.jpg,
                brown-syrup.jpg, cane-syrup.jpg, tapioca.jpg, passion-juice.jpg   (~4:3)
illustrations/  (already added — paths set in src/pages/Delivery.jsx)

To rename or add files, edit src/data.js and the illustration paths in src/pages/Delivery.jsx.
